review_notes: Inspected all 261 lines, the pool coding and prefix-word definitions, Stage, and downstream geometric-value uses. Found one targeted simp-interface improvement. No Lean execution was performed; the proposed addition is untested.

exact fun x y z => if
    x.2.1 = y.2.1 ∧ x.2.1 = z.2.1 ∧
      decodePool pool k counts p x.2.1 = fine p x.1 y.1 z.1 ∧ x.2.2 = y.2.2

findings.problem: There is no observation-level simp rule reducing `decodedLeading pool k counts fine p x y z ≠ 0` to its guard. The actual consumer `surviving_nextPrefix` consequently unfolds the implementation inside a contradiction proof merely to recover the decoding equality. Existing conditional rules apply once the definition is exposed, but the wrapper has no corresponding simp interface.
findings.proposed_change: Add a new `[simp]` lemma with statement `decodedLeading pool k counts fine p x y z ≠ 0 ↔ x.2.1 = y.2.1 ∧ x.2.1 = z.2.1 ∧ decodePool pool k counts p x.2.1 = fine p x.1 y.1 z.1 ∧ x.2.2 = y.2.2`. Prove it by unfolding decodedLeading and applying `Ne.ite_ne_right_iff` with complex `one_ne_zero`. Use the resulting guard to extract hdecode in surviving_nextPrefix.
findings.benefit: Makes nonvanishing normalize directly to the conditions users need without globally expanding tensor values into conditionals. The rewrite removes decodedLeading, introduces no recursive occurrence, and needs no positivity assumption; k = 0 is vacuous because the coordinates contain Fin 0.
